frame: site metres: x east, y up from the median ground, z south
source: USGS 3D Elevation Program LiDAR, project NY_NewYorkCity, read from AWS Open Data (usgs-lidar-public)
derived_note: The survey labels ground and some buildings. Unlabelled points are classed by us: near the ground (road if inside an OpenStreetMap road width), inside a building footprint, or vegetation from multiple returns.
